# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Blue Heat: Suburban Escalation as a browser-native, portrait-first real-time graph strategy game. Preserve the exact source mechanics: the player selects one starting node, starts a match, all nodes become owned factions with equal starting units, owned nodes produce units up to a cap, dragging from an owned node to an adjacent node sends half its units, travelling units reinforce allies or damage/capture rivals, capitals trigger faction annexation, AI sends half-units on a cadence, a temporary cooldown ability blocks hostile AI pushes into player nodes, speed can cycle, and the player wins by owning the whole graph or loses when no owned nodes/troops remain.

Theme every safe surface as a satirical chemistry-front crime escalation. Nodes are suburban fronts such as RV Lab, Car Wash, DEA Van, Cartel Plaza, and Boss Compound. Units are crews/stash pressure. Devastation is heat and consequence. The temporary truce button is Lawyer Call. Use cyan chemistry glow, acid green, amber warning, red heat, scanline dread, procedural front-lab markers, and mobile-readable HUD panels.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a real-time graph strategy game. The player first selects one node as their starting faction, then every node becomes an equal faction with 100 units and a capital marker. Owned nodes produce units over time up to a cap. The player drags from an owned node to an adjacent node to send half of that node's units. Incoming units reinforce friendly nodes or damage/capture enemy nodes. AI factions periodically send half their units toward favorable neighbors. Capturing a capital annexes that faction. The player wins when no enemy nodes remain and loses when they have no nodes or travelling units.

## Protected mechanics
- Select any node before start.
- Start assigns player ownership to the selected node and assigns every other node to its own faction.
- Node production rate, unit cap, devastation/cap reduction, troop speed, send-half behavior, adjacency requirement, AI cadence, capital annex, win/loss checks, pause/restart, speed cycling, and temporary AI attack block are preserved.
- Pointer/touch input remains canvas-based: tap to choose, press/drag/release to send.

## Remixed identity
Blue Heat: Suburban Escalation reframes the same graph war as a satirical chemistry-front crime spiral. Nodes are suburban fronts, travelling units are crews/stash pressure, capitals are front labs, devastation is heat/consequence, AI factions are cartel/patrol rivals, and the temporary peace tool becomes Lawyer Call.

## Canonical runtime
`index.html` is the rebuilt public surface. `index_old.html` is reference-only legacy evidence.
